ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, quadrilateral ABCD is inscribed in $\odot O$, and point M is on the extension of AD. If $\angle AOC = 142^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle CDM$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle AOC=142^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle B=71^\circ$,\\
since quadrilateral ABCD is inscribed in $\odot O$,\\
it implies that $\angle B+\angle ADC=180^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle ADC=142^\circ$,\\
which means $\angle CDM=180^\circ-142^\circ=71^\circ$,\\
hence, the answer is: $\boxed{71^\circ}$.
